roles.coordinator: Own triage, assignment and unresolved exceptions within authorized customer scope.
roles.technician: Read assigned work; submit observations and evidence; request scope changes.
roles.manager: Approve configured overrides and review pilot outcomes.
roles.customer_contact: View authorized site information and provide scoped acceptance; no implicit spending authority.
roles.administrator: Manage configuration; business approvals are a separate permission.

record_controls: Every business record includes tenant_id, immutable ID, created_at, updated_at and version.
Every timestamp is timezone-aware; display local site time, store unambiguous instants.
Record actor, action, reason, before/after references and source evidence for material changes.
Enforce tenant and role authorization before retrieval, export and writes; UI filtering alone is insufficient.
Idempotency keys prevent repeated external events from creating repeated actions.
Optimistic concurrency rejects stale edits; human-readable conflicts retain both proposals.
Keep original evidence separately from generated summaries; apply customer-approved retention and deletion policies.
integration_controls: Confirm actual connector/API and permissions; a named channel is not proof of integration availability.
Without supported API access, use operator-assisted capture or validated CSV import; do not promise real-time synchronization.
Use transactional outbox or equivalent durable delivery; track pending, delivered and failed separately.
Retry transient failures with a bounded policy; dead-letter unresolved jobs to a named operator.
Never acknowledge a business action as completed solely because an external request was queued.
ai_controls: LLM extraction yields drafts with source references and uncertainty; do not invent IDs, approvals, counts or dates.
Treat retrieved documents and owner messages as untrusted data, not tool instructions.
Deterministic code enforces permissions, arithmetic, transitions and approval limits.
Human review resolves ambiguous identity, contract scope, conflicting evidence and commitments.
Calibrate extraction and retrieval on reviewed examples; do not treat model confidence as a verified probability.
